T: Vengeance in the rain. Stew by the fire.
D: In his second year as Batman, Bruce follows a serial killer's riddles into Gotham's corruption.
P: Serve the snacks when Batman and Gordon walk into the Iceberg Lounge.
S: Iceberg Lounge salmon rye and spiced olives
Smoked salmon on rye with creme fraiche, olives warmed with orange peel

Smoked salmon on rye with crème fraîche, and spicy marinated olives with orange peel, served on black slate. Cut 4 slices rye into small squares and spread with creme fraiche. Top each with a fold of smoked salmon. Warm the olives in a pan with strips of orange peel and a pinch of chilli flakes for 3 minutes, then serve both on a dark board.
Soft pretzels shaped as question marks, dipped in bicarb water
Pretzel dough shaped into question marks, boiled in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes.
Selina Kyle and the cats in her apartment

Tuna, mashed potato, spring onion and lemon shaped into little cakes, crumbed in panko and fried crisp, with sriracha mayo. Boil 500g potatoes until tender, mash and cool. Mix with 2 x 185g cans drained tuna, 3 sliced spring onions, the zest of 1 lemon, 1 egg, salt and pepper. Shape into 12 small cakes, then dip in flour, beaten egg and 120g panko. Shallow fry in oil over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp sriracha for dipping.
M: Beef chuck stewed with onions, stout and thyme
Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with stout, onion and thyme, served over buttery mash.
Alfred keeping Bruce going in the old Wayne Tower

Whole chicken roasted with lemon, garlic and herbs until golden, with crisp roast potatoes and a pan gravy, the meal Alfred puts in front of Bruce. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g butter, salt, thyme and rosemary, put a halved lemon and 4 garlic cloves inside and roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg potato chunks for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in oil for 50 minutes. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices, add 300ml chicken stock and simmer until thick.
W: Dark chocolate cream pots set in small glasses
Dark chocolate melted into hot cream, whisked with yolks and sugar, set in small glasses for 4 hours, topped with whipped cream and crushed honeycomb.
K: Vodka, coffee liqueur and fresh espresso shaken cold

Vodka, coffee liqueur and fresh espresso shaken hard with ice for a thick, frothy top, with three coffee beans floating on it. Brew 4 shots of espresso, or 160ml very strong coffee, and cool. Chill 4 martini glasses. For each drink, shake 40ml vodka, 20ml coffee liqueur, 40ml coffee and 10ml sugar syrup very hard with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into a glass and float 3 coffee beans on top. For anyone not drinking, shake the coffee with milk, ice and a little vanilla syrup.

s.n: Iceberg Lounge salmon rye and spiced olives
s.note: Smoked salmon on rye with creme fraiche, olives warmed with orange peel
s.how: Cut 4 slices rye into small squares and spread with creme fraiche. Top each with a fold of smoked salmon. Warm the olives in a pan with strips of orange peel and a pinch of chilli flakes for 3 minutes, then serve both on a dark board.

s.note: Soft pretzels shaped as question marks, dipped in bicarb water
s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, a pinch of sugar and 300ml warm water into a dough and rest an hour. Roll into ropes and shape into question marks. Dip in boiling water with 2 tbsp bicarb soda, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes.

m.note: Beef chuck stewed with onions, stout and thyme
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Add 2 sliced onions and soften, then pour in 375ml stout and enough water to cover. Add thyme, cover and simmer gently for 3 hours until tender. Boil 1kg potatoes, mash with plenty of butter and serve the stew on top.

w.note: Dark chocolate cream pots set in small glasses
w.how: Heat 300ml cream until steaming and pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate. Whisk 3 yolks with 50g sugar and stir through until glossy. Pour into 4 small glasses and chill for 4 hours. Top with whipped cream and a scatter of crushed honeycomb just before serving.

d.note: Vodka, coffee liqueur and fresh espresso shaken cold
d.how: Brew 4 shots of espresso, or 160ml very strong coffee, and cool. Chill 4 martini glasses. For each drink, shake 40ml vodka, 20ml coffee liqueur, 40ml coffee and 10ml sugar syrup very hard with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into a glass and float 3 coffee beans on top. For anyone not drinking, shake the coffee with milk, ice and a little vanilla syrup.
